related.title: CPU 管線與分支預測
related.why: 共用記憶體順序及停頓分析
related.transfer: 共用記憶體順序及停頓分析
related.difference: 跨核心協定需管理遠端訊息，CPU 管線主要管理本地指令
related.differenceEn: Coherence manages remote messages; pipelines manage local instructions
practice: 由「快取一致性與記憶體順序」畫出兩課共用與需要重定義的資料、控制及時間邊界。
針對「跨核心協定需管理遠端訊息，CPU 管線主要管理本地指令」各指定一個能辨識差異的實驗；只使用虛構資料或明確授權隔離環境。
將本課算例移植到衍生課：逐項重查方程適用條件、單位、版本、故障假設，標示不能沿用的數字。
practiceEn: From coherence and consistency, map shared and redefined data, control and timing boundaries.

For "Coherence manages remote messages; pipelines manage local instructions", specify a discriminating experiment for each course using fictional data or an explicitly authorized isolated environment.
Transfer the worked example: recheck equation scope, units, versions and fault assumptions; mark values that cannot carry over.

courses.summaryEn: The course connects public principles and large-system handoffs through coherence states, directories and sharing granularity. Maps identify representative vendors, standards institutions or research/open-technology references; no institutional teaching or universal implementation-site claim is made.

history.year: 公開技術脈絡 / Public technical context
history.title: 共享記憶體契約
history.text: 官方公開資料「快取一致性協定」提供架構脈絡；本課先由「快取一致性與記憶體順序」及「快取行粒度」建立邊界，再進入實驗判讀。這是原創教材的學習順序，不是宣稱技術發明年代。
history.textEn: The primary reference Cache coherence protocols supplies architectural context. These original lessons start with coherence and consistency and cache-line granularity before experiments; this is a learning sequence, not an invention-date claim.

roles.role: 多核 Xeon 的網格互連與一致性目錄設計。
roles.roleEn: Mesh interconnect and coherence directories in multicore Xeons.

roles.businessEn: Designs and manufactures x86 processors and runs a foundry, networking and AI-accelerator businesses.

courses.connection: 從「快取一致性多核心系統」的材料、設備、設計、量測或系統整合問題，延伸查閱下列公司與機構的官方資料；這是教材關聯，不代表合作、採購、背書或投資建議。
courses.connectionEn: Explore official information from companies and institutions related to the materials, equipment, design, measurement or system integration in Cache-coherent multicore systems. This is a learning association, not a partnership, procurement, endorsement or investment advice.
